title: QueueLifecycleEvent
description: Append-only log of queue/CI/repair lifecycle events from Tend merge lane

eventId.description: Stable unique identifier for deduplication across crash/resume cycles

timestamp.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the event was recorded

prNumber.description: GitHub PR number affected by this event

headSha.description: Commit SHA of the PR head at the time of the event

candidateId.description: Stable ID for the candidate prepared; included even for single-entry candidates

attempt.description: CI attempt number for check_run_completed events

actor.description: Author of a repair commit (repair_commit_pushed only)

reason.description: Reason for ejection, abandonment, or dequeue (context-dependent)

executedModel.description: Model that executed for a repair commit, or null if unknown
